description: Upstage provides OpenAI-compatible access to its Solar language models.
residency_notes: Upstage's API terms say it does not store API input/output data or use it for service R&D/training by default. Exceptions include asynchronous API input until completion (up to 3 days), asynchronous outputs up to 30 days, Agent API operation, and third-party model policies; the public materials do not identify one fixed API execution or storage region.
prompt_training_notes: Upstage's API terms say API input/output data is not used for service research, development, or model training by default, with temporary storage exceptions for asynchronous and Agent API features.

sources.notes: Official quick start documents authentication and the OpenAI-compatible Solar API endpoint.
Official chat documentation lists current Solar model aliases.

verification.notes: Direct provider configuration verified against official Upstage documentation.
